advice.strongestCounterargument: RB tier 9 shows eitherRemains 99.3% with an expected 2.6 members still available at pick 49 - Judkins 56.7%, Montgomery 70.3%, Swift 66.7% - so we can very likely still get a startable tier-9 back next turn, while Drake Maye survives only 64% and QB tier 3 is flagged atRisk.

advice.expectedNextPickPlan: At the 49/52 turn take a QB from tier 3 (Hurts 98.3%, Daniels 96%, or Burrow 76.7% survival) and a TE from tier 3 (Kraft 98.3%, Warren 80.3%), with a tier-9/10 RB or WR such as Montgomery, Swift or TreVeyon Henderson as the fallback if a tier-3 TE unexpectedly clears out; that fills QB, TE and leaves 69/72 for FLEX bodies.
